notes.title: v1.1 Patch fixes!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for reporting bugs they found in the release version of The Protagonish! Fixed in this update are (in order of hilarity):
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the fox would appear to be on fire after resuming from menu
[*] Adventurer would randomly yell distances during a few monk exchanges
[*] Fixed instances where the Adventurer got stuck after being sent on quest
[*] Adventurer no longer yells over himself in front of the miner
[*] Too many options in Beastie dialogue
[*] Clouds and titles didn't restart on game restart
[*] Improved quest linkages between characters
[/list]

If you find more, please let us know in the forums here, and we try and get them fixed ASAP! 

You lovely players are the MVPs!
